page.layout: Two printed columns of running text on one page, with a line-number gutter (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) between them. Left column, top to bottom: a dictionary of authors' works. Right column, top to bottom: continued entries, ending with the line "Ordi-" above the signature. The running head "THO" and the page number 661 stand at the top, the signature "Kk" at the foot right.

page.notes: Printed page number 661 is at the top right; the left page has no printed number. Gutter numbers 10, 20 ... 60 are line-count markers printed between the columns. Running head "THO" printed on both pages. Some abbreviations and names in the left column were read at small size and may contain errors; the transcription of the entry for Thomas Dockinga and the Ordinationes line is especially uncertain. The text "Ordi-" at the foot of the right column is a line ending with a hyphen, continued on the next page. The word "NOTIONIS" in the right column was read at low resolution and is a doubtful reading; it is printed as "speciem" in the scan and should be checked.
